summary: Validator for plan toolchain-workflow-repair; supports initial-plan-ready and authorized-repair-revalidate modes; requires 10 named artifacts plus 3 tools under execution-plans; validates self-hosted contract, slices W0-W6, TDD intent, command registry, authority partitions, resume state, architecture acceptance, fixed baseline/candidate commits, exact delta paths and bound hashes, knowledge preflight/freeze, accepted modules, and canonical skill-input receipt; draft state authorizes nothing; plan-ready requires valid publication receipt bound to validation hash; authorized repair requires implementation-authorized plan and closed repair round with no blocks/authorizations; outputs pass/fail receipt with no authorizations and optional input-manifest hash; missing or malformed artifacts produce failure.
